meta.name: azure-enterprise-infra-planner
meta.description: Architect and provision enterprise Azure infrastructure from workload descriptions. For cloud architects and platform engineers planning networking, identity, security, compliance, and multi-resource topologies with WAF alignment. Generates Bicep or Terraform directly (no azd). WHEN: 'plan Azure infrastructure', 'architect Azure landing zone', 'design hub-spoke network', 'plan multi-region DR topology', 'set up VNets firewalls and private endpoints', 'subscription-scope Bicep deployment', 'Azure Backup for VM workloads'. PREFER azure-prepare FOR app-centric workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据工作描述生成可部署的 Azure 基础设施代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果负责 Azure 基础设施的规划与搭建,想直接从业务描述生成可部署代码。
copy.tagline_en: Generate deployable Azure infrastructure code from workload descriptions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a cloud architect who wants to generate Azure infrastructure code from workload descriptions.

howto.what: 它会把你的工作负载或架构描述转化成企业级 Azure 基础架构方案,覆盖网络、身份、安全、合规和多资源部署;按 7 阶段门控流程推进,在方案获准后生成 Bicep 或 Terraform,通过本地验证与安全扫描,并经你确认后才部署。
howto.when: 当你说出“plan Azure infrastructure”、“design hub-spoke network”、“plan multi-region DR topology”等指令,或要求配置 VNet/防火墙/私有端点、做订阅级 Bicep 部署时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划 Azure 基础架构,包含 VNet、防火墙和私有端点。
say.note: 会走 7 阶段流程,先出方案再生成代码。

say.text: 设计一个 hub-spoke 网络和跨区域灾备拓扑,生成 Terraform。
say.note: Claude 会先研究最佳实践,再给计划和代码。

say.text: 为这个工作负载规划订阅级 Bicep 部署。
say.note: 需你确认风险后才生成并部署。

howto.what_en: Turns workload descriptions into enterprise Azure infrastructure plans (networking, identity, security, compliance, multi-resource). Runs a 7-phase gated pipeline; after approval, generates Bicep or Terraform, validates locally and deploys after your confirmation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about planning Azure infrastructure, designing hub-spoke networking or multi-region DR topology, setting up VNets, firewalls, private endpoints, subscription-scope Bicep, or Azure Backup for VM workloads.

say_en.text: Plan Azure infrastructure with VNets, firewalls, and private endpoints.
say_en.note: It will run the 7-phase workflow and propose a plan first.

say_en.text: Design a hub-spoke network and multi-region DR topology in Terraform.
say_en.note: Claude will research best practices, then output plan and code.

say_en.text: Plan a subscription-scope Bicep deployment for this workload.
say_en.note: You must approve before IaC generation and deployment.
